passage:
On Saturday, Tushar simply switched off the tablet in the middle of the penguin show. Five-year-old Pema threw herself on the rug and screamed until her face went red. "It wasn't finished!" she sobbed.
On Sunday, Tushar tried something new. "Pema, two more minutes, then it's time to feed the fish," he said, sitting beside her. When the episode ended, he held out the little tub of fish food. Pema pouted and folded her arms. Then she took the tub and ran to the tank on the windowsill of their Kolkata flat, counting the orange fish.

qa.q: What did Tushar hold out when the episode ended on Sunday?
qa.a: He held out the little tub of fish food.

qa.q: Why did Pema scream on Saturday?
qa.a: She felt shocked and angry because the show was cut off in the middle, before it was finished.

qa.q: Which approach worked better, and why?
qa.a: The Sunday one, because the warning and the fish feeding gave Pema time to get ready and something nice to move to.

qa.q: What was Saturday like for Tushar?
qa.a: It was probably stressful and upsetting for him to watch her scream until her face went red.

grounding: It shows a young child melting down when a show ends suddenly, and how a warning and a pleasant next activity soften the change.

passage:
"Nitin, the timer says five minutes left on the racing game," Papa said.
"Okay."
The timer beeped. "That's time, champ."
"No! One more race! Papa, one more!"
"I know. It's hard to stop when it's exciting."
"You're mean!" Nitin stamped his foot and kicked the cushion.
"You're cross. That's okay," said Harish, Nitin's father, calmly. "Want to race me on bikes to the park instead?"
Nitin sulked. "Real racing?"
"Real racing. You can have the red helmet."
A long pause. "I'm going to win."
"We'll see."

qa.q: What does Harish offer Nitin instead of the game?
qa.a: He offers to race him on bikes to the park, with the red helmet.

qa.q: How is Nitin feeling when the timer beeps?
qa.a: He is angry and frustrated at having to stop, so he shouts and kicks the cushion.
He gave a warning, stayed calm, named the feeling and offered an exciting real-world activity next.

qa.q: How might Harish feel when Nitin calls him mean?
qa.a: Harish might feel a little stung, but he stays calm and does not take it personally, knowing Nitin is cross about stopping.

grounding: It shows a young child sulking when a game ends and a parent softening the switch with a warning and a fun next activity.
